title: ci(lint): measure where `Lint & Repo Gates`' 198 serial steps spend 14–37 minutes, and bring the maintainer a split plan (maintainer-directed)
body:
Protects: the merge queue's required context `Lint & Repo Gates` (AGENTS.md:519), the published check-run name every PR, merge group and release of `@objectstack/*` passes through; this card keeps the name and cuts its wall.
Ruled: 6120820653 · letter D · 2026-10-12T08:44Z

Filing gate **③**: a maintainer-directed task. In the `domain:devx` seat 1 session (`session_012yK1ddAdAqfzwigRHZq3r2`), the maintainer asked「22973 一个 ci 30 分钟还没跑完，其他主流类似的系统也是这么慢吗」. The seat answered with the readings below and offered a card to measure the job's step-time distribution and bring back a split plan. The maintainer replied, verbatim:「开卡吧」.

**Reader who acts:** `domain:devx` seat 1 dispatches the measurement (part 1). The split plan (part 2) goes to the maintainer as a decision with the four-axis analysis. ⛔ `lint.yml` is not restructured before that ruling. Lane and grade are triage's.

## What is measured (seat 1, 2026-10-12)

- **PR #22973** (head `ef3d0764b`): 31 of its 32 non-skipped checks finished within 8.5 minutes. Test Core's slowest shard was 8.5 min, Type Check 3–4 min, Build Docs 3.6 min. `Lint & Repo Gates` alone was still running at 32 minutes, with 128 of its 197 steps done.
- **`Lint & Repo Gates`, newest completed runs** (`lint.yml`, jobs API, 05:06Z–07:50Z):

  | event | runs | min | median | p90 | max |
  |:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
  | `pull_request` | 24 | 6.1 | 14.3 | 20.9 | 35.9 |
  | `merge_group` | 25 | 10.5 | 15.5 | 34.5 | 37.6 |

  Every run has 198 steps in one job on one runner.
- **It is the job the queue waits on about half the time.** In 13 of those 25 merge groups, `Lint & Repo Gates` finished after the whole `CI` workflow of the same group, by up to 23.3 minutes. The differences, lint end minus CI end in minutes, run −14.3 … +23.3.
- **The workflow's size:** `lint.yml` has 7186 lines and 284 `- name:` steps, 199 `pnpm check:` invocations and 118 `node scripts/` invocations. `scripts/` holds 165 `check-*.mjs` files.

## What to do

1. **Measure** (dispatchable). Read the step-level `started_at` / `completed_at` that the jobs API returns, over a window of PR and merge_group runs. Report:
   - each step's median and p90;
   - the top steps by share of the job;
   - which steps are already path-scoped by `scripts/ci/select-gate-families.sh` (#16496), and which run on every PR;
   - the `needs` chain, if a later step needs an earlier one's output.
   ⛔ No change to `lint.yml` in this part.
2. **Propose** (for the maintainer's ruling). Give options with workload and four-axis analysis, at least these:
   - (a) split the job into N parallel lanes behind an aggregator that keeps the required `Lint & Repo Gates` context. The precedent is `TypeScript Type Check` and its `Type Check · *` lanes in the same file.
   - (b) extend #16496's per-family path scoping to the steps that still run on every PR.
   - (c) a cache for gates whose inputs did not change.
   - (d) a combination.
   Name the critical path each option is expected to reach, as a measurement-backed estimate, never a guess.

## Prior work (read before proposing)

- #16496 (closed `completed`, PR #16754): `select-gate-families.sh`, path-scoped families on merge groups.
- #22076 (closed `completed`): the PM dispatch-gates self-test, 7.6–13.1 min, was this job's critical path; it was tiered.
- #19189 (closed `not_planned` on 2026-09-25, triage `5831394361`): "Lint & Repo Gates is the merge-group critical path". It was closed because the job then measured 8–14 min at parity with the other legs. Its reopen condition: "a merge group's `Lint & Repo Gates` is again the job the queue waits on". The table above meets that condition in 13 of 25 groups.
- #19686 (closed `duplicate` of #19189): the earlier measured split proposal, "193 serial steps are 28 minutes … the way `TypeScript Type Check` already is".
- #21050: this job's `timeout-minutes`.

## Dedupe

- MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included: "Lint & Repo Gates job duration serial steps shard parallel matrix split lint.yml wall time" → 31 hits, all read by title. None is open.
- The nearest are #19189 and #19686, both closed. This card is new because it is maintainer-directed, and it asks for a measurement and a plan, not an immediate split.
- Dedupe words: Lint & Repo Gates; serial steps; critical path; split lanes; aggregator; select-gate-families.
